channel.title: Guttmann Research Lab News
channel.description: Research explainers, caregiver resources and program updates from the Guttmann Research Lab at the University of West Florida.

item.title: The Guttmann Research Lab has a new home on the web
item.description: The lab website now lives at guttmannlab.org, with an updated CV, a news page, and regular posts on Alzheimer's research, caregiver resources and student programs.

item.title: NeuroNauts Scholars: how a summer neuroscience program for high school students works
item.description: The NeuroNauts Scholars Program places high school students from Escambia and Santa Rosa Counties in University of West Florida research labs for eight weeks. Here is how it works and how selection happens.
